before.getConfig_exception_confirmed: Custom Android map build requires an owner-authorized Maps key in the build environment.

root_cause: An app.config top-level missing-key guard ran during EAS metadata bootstrap, before EAS fetched cloud variables. JSON-mode logging suppression hid the exception. Not a Windows spawn/Node runtime incompatibility.
fix: Require EAS_BUILD=true and EAS_BUILD_PLATFORM=android for the existing profile key guard; retain maps:check and native worker rejection.
private_logs: Ignored backups only; no raw environment, key, token or resolved private config in public evidence.
